questions.question_text: Two point charges 4.9 μC and 4.9 μC are placed 0.10 m apart in free space. Calculate the electrostatic force between them. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N·m²/C²)
questions.explanation:
### Concept
Direct force from Coulomb law

### Scenario
Two identical charges in vacuum

### Solution
Using F = kq₁q₂/r² with k = 9×10⁹ N·m²/C²:
F = (9×10⁹ × 4.9×10⁻⁶ × 4.9×10⁻⁶) / (0.10)² = 2.16e+1 N

### Solving Path
Identify: q₁ = 4.9 μC, q₂ = 4.9 μC, r = 0.10 m
Apply Coulomb's law: F = kq₁q₂/r²
F = 9×10⁹ × 4.9×10⁻⁶ × 4.9×10⁻⁶ / (0.10)²
F ≈ 2.16e+1 N

### Common Mistakes
Confusing F ∝ r² with F ∝ 1/r². Remember: force DECREASES with r.
solution_steps: Identify: q₁ = 4.9 μC, q₂ = 4.9 μC, r = 0.10 m

questions.explanation:
### Concept
Force in medium via K

### Scenario
Two unequal charges

### Solution
Using F = kq₁q₂/r² with k = 9×10⁹ N·m²/C²:
F = (9×10⁹ × 4.7×10⁻⁶ × 8.1×10⁻⁶) / (0.50)² = 1.37e+0 N

### Solving Path
Identify: q₁ = 4.7 μC, q₂ = 8.1 μC, r = 0.50 m
Apply Coulomb's law: F = kq₁q₂/r²
F = 9×10⁹ × 4.7×10⁻⁶ × 8.1×10⁻⁶ / (0.50)²
F ≈ 1.37e+0 N

### Common Mistakes
Confusing F ∝ r² with F ∝ 1/r². Remember: force DECREASES with r.
solution_steps: Identify: q₁ = 4.7 μC, q₂ = 8.1 μC, r = 0.50 m
